info.title: rupta API
info.description: Management and query API of rupta. Authenticate with the `rupta_session` cookie plus the `X-CSRF-Token` header on mutating requests, or with `Authorization: Bearer rpt_...`. See docs/api.md.

post.summary:
Receives a tracker's webhook. Verified with the integration's webhook
secret (see docs/integrations.md); unknown integrations and failed
verification answer 401. Redeliveries (same delivery id) answer 200
without effect.

requestBody.description: The tracker's webhook payload, as the tracker sends it

get.summary: Log records, newest first.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project ids or slugs, comma-separated (default: every project of
the organization).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Time range back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `14d` (default 24h, at
most 366d). Ignored when `start` is given.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601, default now).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Filter: free text matches the body (substring); `level:error`,
`level:[warn,error]`, `trace:<id>`, `span:<id>`, `release:`,
`sdk:`, `severity:>=17`, `body:`/`message:` (substring); any other
`key:value` matches an attribute. `!` negates a term.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `-timestamp` (newest first, default) or `timestamp`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 1000, default 100.

get.summary: Log counts per interval and level.

parameters.name: project

the organization).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Time range back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `14d` (default 24h, at
most 366d). Ignored when `start` is given.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Same filter as the log list.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: `1m`, `1h` or `1d` (default: chosen from the range).

get.summary:
Live tail: new log records as Server-Sent Events. Each `logs` event
carries a JSON array of records (oldest first); a `lagging` event
`{"skipped": n}` reports records skipped because more than 500 arrived
within a second. The stream polls once per second and ends after 30
minutes; reconnect to continue. Only records received after the
stream started are sent.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project ids or slugs, comma-separated (default: every project of
the organization).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Time range back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `14d` (default 24h, at
most 366d). Ignored when `start` is given.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601, default now).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Same filter as the log list.

200.description: `text/event-stream` with `logs` events (data: JSON array of log records)

Removes a member (or leaves, when it is the caller). The last owner

patch.summary:
Changes a member's role. Admins cannot touch owners; the last owner

get.summary: A metric aggregated over time, optionally one series per attribute value.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project ids or slugs, comma-separated (default: every project of
the organization).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Time range back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `14d` (default 24h, at
most 366d). Ignored when `start` is given.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601, default now).

parameters.name: op
parameters.description:
`sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max`, `count`, `count_unique` (sets), `p50`,
`p75`, `p95`, `p99`. Default: `sum` for counters, `avg` for gauges,
`p95` for distributions, `count_unique` for sets.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description:
An attribute name, or `environment` / `release`: one series per value
(the 10 largest by total).

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: `1m`, `1h` or `1d` (default: chosen from the range).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter: `key:value` on attributes, `release:`, `trace:`, `value:>n`.

get.summary:
Transactions grouped by name: throughput, latency percentiles,
failure rate and Apdex.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project ids or slugs, comma-separated (default: every project of
the organization).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Time range back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `14d` (default 24h, at
most 366d). Ignored when `start` is given.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601, default now).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Filter: free text matches the name; keys `op`, `status`, `release`,
`platform`, `sdk`, `trace`, `duration` (ms, comparisons), any other
key matches a tag.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
`tpm` (default), `count`, `p50`, `p95`, `p99`, `failure_rate`,
`apdex`, `name`; prefix `-` for ascending (`-p95`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 100, default 50.

get.summary:
The span explorer: spans grouped by operation, description or
transaction with counts and latency, or the matching spans themselves.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project ids or slugs, comma-separated (default: every project of
the organization).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description:
Time range back from now, e.g. `1h`, `24h`, `14d` (default 24h, at

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the range (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601, default now).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Filter: free text matches the description; keys `op`,
`description` (substring), `transaction`, `status`, `release`,

302.description: into the app; on failure to `/login?error=sso_no_access` when the user's claims map to no role and the default role is `none`, else to `/login?error=sso_failed`

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: `oidc` or `org-{slug}`

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Local path to open after signing in.

name.description: For a new account: name and password.

id.description:
The tracker's id of the account (Jira account id or user name,
Linear user id, GitHub or GitLab login).

AccountRef.description:
Who the stored credentials belong to, as the tracker reported at the
last successful check.

kind.description:
`comment`, `status_change`, `assigned`, `unassigned`,
`priority_change`, kinds recorded by ingestion (e.g. `first_seen`,
`regression`), and for issue trackers `ticket_linked`,
`ticket_unlinked`, `ticket_status_change` (a webhook changed the
ticket) and `ticket_sync` (rupta commented on or moved a ticket;
`data.ok` and `data.error`). A `status_change` caused by a ticket
has `data.source: "integration"`.

AlertFire.description: An alert rule that fired for an issue.

oneOf.description: `null` when the issue has been deleted since.

actions.description:
`{type: channel, channel_id}`, `{type: email, user_ids, team_ids}`,
`{type: create_ticket, integration_id, target?, issue_type?,
project?, labels?}` (once per issue; target and the rest default to
the project's defaults for the integration).

conditions.description:
Any of: `{type: first_seen}`, `{type: regression}`,
`{type: reappeared}`, `{type: escalating}`,
`{type: event_frequency, count, interval}`,
`{type: user_frequency, count, interval}` (interval like `1h`).

filters.description:
All of: `{type: level, level, match: eq|gte}`,
`{type: environment, value}`, `{type: tag, key, value}`.

frequency_minutes.description: At most one notification per issue and rule in this many minutes.

environment.description: Only events of this environment (empty string: any).

time_end.description: End of a region (deploys with a start time), Unix milliseconds.

debug_ids_count.description: Distinct debug ids of the bundle's files.

download_url.description: API path to download the file.

local_login.description: Email and password login is available.

setup_required.description: No user exists yet: the setup form should be shown.

sso.description: Single sign-on providers to offer as login buttons.

Category.description: `open` or `done`: what rupta makes of a tracker status.

config.description:
email: `{to: [..]}`; slack and teams: `{webhook_url}`; webhook:
`{url, has_secret}` (the secret is write-only); pagerduty:
`{region, api_url, has_secret}` (the routing key is write-only);
opsgenie: `{region, api_url, has_secret}` (the API key is write-only).

slug.description: Derived from the name if omitted.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the token expires; none = never.

CurrentUser.description: The signed-in user with their preferences.

widgets.description:
Widgets: `{id, title, type, chart, query, layout}` where `type` is
`metric`, `transactions`, `logs` or `issues`, `chart` is `line`,
`area`, `bar`, `table` or `number`, `query` holds the parameters of
the matching query endpoint and `layout` is `{x, y, w, h}` on a
12-column grid. Stored as given after validation.

ErrorBody.description: The error body, for the OpenAPI document.

FiredIssue.description: The issue of an alert firing.

FiredRule.description: The rule of an alert firing.

FlamegraphOut.description:
A flamegraph. Children are in the order first sampled (time order);
sort by `total_weight` for a left-heavy view.

threads.description: Threads of the profile with their sample counts (single profiles).

adoption.description:
Share (percent) of the projects' sessions in the last 24 hours
that used this release.

crash_free_sessions.description: Percent of sessions that did not crash; `null` without sessions.

crash_free_users.description:
Percent of users without a crashed session; `null` without
sessions that carry a `did`.

crashed_users.description: Distinct users with at least one crashed session.

end.description:
Upper bound in milliseconds (exclusive; the last bucket also holds
everything slower).

InstanceSso.description: The instance-wide single sign-on provider (`RUPTA_OIDC_*`), read-only.

allowed_audiences.description:
Audiences besides the client id that ID tokens may carry
(`RUPTA_OIDC_ALLOWED_AUDIENCES`); empty = any.

default_org.description:
Slug of the organization users join when they sign in with this
provider (`RUPTA_DEFAULT_ORG`).

default_role.description: Role for users whose claims map to no role, or `none` (refused).

has_client_secret.description: Whether a client secret is set; the secret is never returned.

redirect_uri.description: Register this URI at the provider.

InstanceSsoInfo.description:
Instance-wide sign-in settings as far as an organization's settings
page needs them.

local_login.description: Email and password login is enabled (`RUPTA_LOCAL_LOGIN`).

oneOf.description: The provider configured by environment variables; `null` if none.

Integration.description: A connection to an issue tracker.

last_error.description: The last failed call or check, cleared by the next success.

token_hint.description: The token, masked: `****` and its last four characters.

rotate_webhook_secret.description: Generates a new webhook secret, returned once.

token.description: API token, API key or personal access token. Write-only.

validate.description:
Check the credentials against the tracker before saving (default
true).

webhook_secret.description:
The webhook secret. Write-only. For Linear, the signing secret
Linear shows for the webhook; for the others rupta generates one at
creation when none is given.

IntegrationRef.description: A short reference to an integration.

webhook_secret.description: Set only when rupta generated a webhook secret in this request.

IntegrationWithSecret.description:
An integration, with the webhook secret when rupta generated one in
this request (shown once).

accept_url.description:
The acceptance link; returned only when it was just created, so an
admin can pass it on when email is not configured.

email_sent.description: Whether the invitation email was sent (needs SMTP).

user_exists.description:
An account with this email exists (log in to accept), otherwise
one can be created when accepting (if password login is enabled).

ignore_count.description: The `times_seen` value at which an ignored issue reappears.

ignore_user_count.description:
Ignored until more users: without `ignore_user_window` the
`users_seen` value at which the issue reappears; with it the number
of distinct users within the window.

permalink.description: Link to the issue in the web app.

resolved_in_mode.description:
How `resolved_in_release` is meant: `release` (resolved in that
version) or `next_release` (resolved in the release after it; it is
the latest release at resolution time and may be `null` when the
project had none). `null` when not resolved in a release.

IssueLink.description: A ticket linked to an issue.

external_id.description: The tracker's stable id (Jira issue id, Linear UUID, `owner/repo#17`, `group/project#17`).

status.description:
The tracker's status name (`In Progress`, `closed`, …), `deleted`
when the ticket was deleted.

synced_at.description: When rupta last learned the ticket's state.

IssueUpdate.description: Changes to one or more issues.

ignore_count.description: With `status: ignored`: further events until it reappears.

ignore_duration.description: With `status: ignored`: minutes until the issue reappears.

ignore_user_count.description: With `status: ignored`: further distinct users until it reappears.

ignore_user_window.description:
With `ignore_user_count`: count the users within this many minutes
(1 to 525600) instead of in total.

resolved_in.description:
With `status: resolved`: `next_release` resolves the issue in the
release after the latest one seen so far (same as `substatus:
in_next_release`).

resolved_in_release.description:
With `status: resolved`: the release that fixes it. Events of that
release and of releases first seen after it regress the issue.

rate_limit_per_min.description: Events per minute for this key; `null` = unlimited.

description.description:
With `create`: replaces the generated description (plain text or
Markdown; a link back to the issue is added).

mode.description: `create` a new ticket (default) or `link` an existing one.

reference.description:
With `link`: a key (`PROJ-123`, `ENG-42`, `owner/repo#17`, `#17`
with a default target) or the ticket's URL.

target.description: With `create`: where (defaults to the project's defaults).

counts.description: Records per level (only levels that occur).

totals.description: Records per level over the whole range.

attributes.description: Attributes as plain JSON values (`{"key": value}`).

level.description: trace, debug, info, warn, error or fatal.

sso_linked.description: Signed in with single sign-on at least once.

truncated.description: True if there were more than 10 groups (only the largest are returned).

total.description: The aggregate over the whole range.

checkin_margin.description: Minutes a check-in may be late.

NodeOut.description:
A call tree node: `frame_index` into `frames` (`null` for the root),
weights in samples.

issue_alerts.description: Emails from alert rules that name the user or one of their teams.

weekly_report.description:
A weekly summary. Stored for the web app; rupta does not send
weekly reports yet.

workflow.description:
Emails when an issue is assigned to the user (or their team) and
when someone comments on an issue assigned to them.

kind.description:
`comment`, `status_change`, `assigned`, `unassigned`,
`priority_change`, kinds recorded by ingestion (e.g. `first_seen`,
`regression`), and for issue trackers `ticket_linked`,
`ticket_unlinked`, `ticket_status_change` (a webhook changed the
ticket) and `ticket_sync` (rupta commented on or moved a ticket;
`data.ok` and `data.error`). A `status_change` caused by a ticket
has `data.source: "integration"`.

items.description: An alert rule that fired for an issue.

timezone.description:
IANA time zone for showing times, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`; `null`
follows the browser.

timezone.description: IANA time zone; `null` or `""` to follow the browser.

size.description: Size of the document in bytes.

dsn.description: DSN of the first active key, for quick setup.

releases.description:
Releases with sessions in the period, most sessions first; `adoption`
is the share of the period's sessions.

series.description:
`[[unix_seconds, sessions, crashed, users, crashed_users]]`; users
are distinct per bucket.

ProjectIntegration.description: How a project uses an integration.

incoming_sync.description: Tracker → rupta: resolve the issue when the ticket is done, unresolve when it is reopened.

outgoing_comment.description: rupta → tracker: comment on resolve, unresolve and regression.

outgoing_transition.description: rupta → tracker: move the ticket to done/open when the issue is resolved/unresolved.

target.description: Jira project key, Linear team id, GitHub `owner/repo`, GitLab project path.

client_secret.description: Omit to keep the stored secret; empty string for a public client.

default_role.description:
Role for users whose claims map to no role: `viewer`, `member`
(default) or `admin`; `none` refuses their sign-in (needs a role
claim and a role mapping). Owners always sign in.

count.description: Events of the issue in this transaction within the range.

The version without a `package@` prefix, shortened if it is a
commit hash.

sessions.description:
Daily `[[unix_seconds, sessions, crashed, users, crashed_users]]`
of the last 14 days (users distinct per day).

issues.description: Issues of errors recorded during the replay.

recording_url.description: API path of the recording segments.

event_ids.description: Error events of the issue during the replay.

shared.description: Visible to the whole organization (otherwise only to its creator).

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on mutating requests; `null` for token auth.

group.description: The value of the grouping column (`null` when unset).

sum_duration_ms.description: Total time spent in these spans, milliseconds.

SpanNode.description: A span with its children (the trace waterfall).

segment_id.description: Span id of the transaction (segment) this span belongs to.

default_role.description:
Role for users whose claims map to no role: `viewer`, `member`,
`admin`, or `none` to refuse their sign-in.

enforce.description: Members must use single sign-on; password login is refused.

owner_local_login.description: With `enforce`, owners may still use their password (break-glass).

client_secret.description: Omit or leave empty for a public client.

issuer.description: The issuer as the provider states it.

ok.description: True when the provider can be used: no problems.

problems.description: What is wrong, in plain words; empty when `ok`.

Where tickets can be created: a Jira project, a Linear team, a GitHub
repository or a GitLab project.

id.description:
Use as `target`: Jira project key, Linear team id, GitHub
`owner/repo`, GitLab project path.

key.description: Jira project key, Linear team key.

labels.description: Linear labels of the team (and workspace labels).

states.description: Linear workflow states of the team.

TestResult.description: The result of a connection test.

error.description: What went wrong, in plain words.

TicketDraftView.description: The generated ticket for an issue, to prefill the create dialog.

description.description: Markdown (Jira receives the same content as ADF or wiki markup).

spans.description:
Root spans of the trace (spans whose parent is not in the trace),
each with its descendants.

truncated.description: True if the trace had more than 10,000 spans and only those were loaded.

span_id.description: The span that was active when the error happened.

TransactionStats.description: One transaction name with its statistics over the range.

failure_rate.description:
Share (0 to 1) of transactions whose status is not `ok`,
`cancelled` or `unknown`.

tpm.description: Transactions per minute over the range.

related_issues.description: Issues with events in this transaction, most events first.

oneOf.description: Overall statistics; `null` if there is no transaction in the range.

settings.description:
Partial settings: given top-level keys replace the stored ones;
`filters` and `scrubbing` are merged key by key.

team.description: Team slug; empty string removes the team.

current_password.description: To change the password, give the current and the new one.

oneOf.description: Only the given fields change; each is validated.
